projectDescription: A retro-styled personal portfolio website built with React, featuring Y2K/Web 1.0 aesthetic components like marquee strips, visitor counters, sparkle cursors, 88x31 badges, and Windows 98-style bevel UI elements.
keyFeatures: Retro Y2K/Web 1.0 aesthetic with teal background, Comic Sans font, and pixel fonts
Windows 98-style bevel container and button components
Animated sparkle cursor following mouse movement
Marquee text strips with configurable content
88x31 pixel badge components for webring-style linking
Page transition animations using Framer Motion
React Router v6 SPA routing with nine pages
Custom CSS animations: blink, marquee, bob, rainbow-text, marching-ants
publicApiSurface: RetroNav — sticky navigation bar with active route highlighting and marching-ants border
MarqueeStrip({ text, className }) — scrolling ticker strip with configurable text and style
SparkleCursor — fixed sparkle effect component following mouse cursor
PageTransition — wraps page content with Framer Motion enter/exit animations
VisitorCounter — animated LED-style visitor counter starting at 1337
WebringBadges — webring membership badge panel with HTML Ring, Geocities, and Web Dev rings
Button88x31({ title, color, textColor, icon }) — 88x31 pixel retro badge button
CSS utility: .font-pixel — VT323 monospace pixel font
CSS utility: .font-comic — Comic Neue cursive font
CSS utility: .rainbow-text — animated rainbow gradient text
CSS utility: .marching-ants — animated dashed selection border
CSS utility: .scanlines — CRT scanline overlay effect
